rawContent: @ShyBuddha @JuddLegum @josephbharding @CarlosGSmith No one wants to believe I’m right. But by the time we realize that I am, it will be too late stop them. Probably already is. I can’t believe how docile we’ve become. For one brief moment, #BLM showed promise. But promise needs leadership. Now it’s just another brand.

If this isn’t an anthem for #blacklivesmatter, there may never be one. This was extraordinary and you should not miss it. Don’t be cynical about the platform. Listen to the poetry, passion and pain. Written 3 days after George Floyd Died.
https://t.co/iB6tHepmeG

Well this got a whopping 5 retweets last night.  Is it something against #AmericanIdol, young black songwriters, #BLM, or the ongoing squelching on my account? Twitter is so weird.   Kitten fart videos get more traction than this. #smh
